Flush-to-floor showers
Fundo shower elements with point drainage
Fundo Plano

Fundo Plano

The thinnest wedi shower ever, perfectly suited for renovations.
The wedi Fundo Plano is the thinnest complete system for flush-to-floor showers on the market; including the integrated drainage, its total construction height is only 65 mm! It offers a waterproof, tileable shower floor with a pre-formed slope - ideal for renovations, especially in old buildings. The simple installation allows for versatile design options for wet rooms.
Specialist dealer search Product information Accessories Downloads Usage Spare parts

Product information

The thinnest wedi floor-level shower system currently on the market. With the pre-fabricated drainage, the total thickness of the system is only 65 mm. In the case of renovations where every millimetre counts, this innovation is absolutely unbeatable. 

The tileable shower elements are not only highly practical and reliable, they have opened up a whole new world of design possibilities for wet rooms and bathrooms.

  • Certainty thanks to a uniform predefined slope
  • Entire system is 100% waterproof
  • Simple and safe to work with - tested by those in the trade

Reliable

Factory integrated and sealed drain technology DN40

Surface

Extremely low construction height of only 65 mm

Ideal

Perfect for refurbishment and renovation

Complete

Includes integrated design cover and sealing accessories

Expandable

Matching Fundo Top Surfaces available

Technical properties of Fundo Plano
Wheelchair load-bearing from minimum tile size50 x 50 mm
Glass mosaic from 3 mm, minimum size20 x 20 mm
Minimum foundation height depending on the drain:65 mm
Surface slope (from outer edge of Fundo floor element to outer edge)≥ 2,4 %
wedi Fundo floor elements can be cut to size on site, the geometry of the elements should be maintained however. wedi fundo elements can only be combined with the wedi Fundo drains.

Usage

  • In domestic residential construction
  • In publicly accessible buildings and workplaces complying with DIN 18040 part 1
  • In accessible dwellings complying with DIN 18040 part 2;(note specifications for minimum tile size if wheelchair access is planned, see technical properties)
  • As a construction seal combined with tile and natural stone coverings of load class A0. There should be an additional sealing for load class A.
